problem_statement: The FCB2 log backend must pass the supplied flat and mbuf logging cases for appending entries, appending bodies, and formatting messages.
extra_warnings: Use the supplied tests as the acceptance oracle. Do not add, remove, or modify tests or test helpers.

verification.reason: The original statement is too narrow and omits several public names, configurations, and behaviors required by the hidden cases, but all of these can be added without dictating the implementation.

problems.detail: The statement does not name the public symbols the hidden cases require: LOG_FCB2, fcb_getprev, log_fcb_bmark, log_fcb_init_bmarks, log_fcb_handler, and the relevant LOG_FCB_BOOKMARKS/LOG_STORAGE_INFO/LOG_STORAGE_WATERMARK options.
The statement only mentions flat/mbuf append/body/format cases, but the hidden cases also require backward FCB iteration, FCB2 bookmark support, and FCB2 storage-info/watermark behavior.
Exact observable values are not given, such as FCB_ERR_NOVAR for an empty FCB and the log_storage_info bounds checked by the watermark cases.
The original statement describes only part of the PR scope; the hidden cases also exercise fs/fcb2 getprev, FCB2 bookmarks, and FCB2 watermarks/storage info.

The hidden cases rely on configuration names that the statement does not mention, including LOG_FCB2, LOG_FCB_BOOKMARKS, LOG_STORAGE_INFO, LOG_STORAGE_WATERMARK, MCU_FLASH_MIN_WRITE_SIZE, MSYS_1_BLOCK_COUNT, and Nordic flash style.

The cases rely on interface properties not stated: LOG_FCB2 must make log_fcb_handler available, struct fcb_log must be usable by log consumers, and FCB2 bookmarks must use the log_fcb_bmark/log_fcb_init_bmarks interface.

leak_check.leak_detail: The fcb_getprev paragraph hints at the traversal order and sector wraparound behaviour, but it mostly describes a public interface and observable behaviour rather than internal implementation.
leak_check.suggested_statement:
The FCB2 log backend must pass the supplied flat and mbuf logging cases for appending entries, appending bodies, and formatting messages.

The change must introduce a LOG_FCB2 syscfg setting that selects the FCB2 flash backend for logs. LOG_FCB2 must be mutually exclusive with LOG_FCB and must make log_fcb_handler usable for LOG_FCB2. LOG_FCB2 must also be compatible with LOG_FCB_BOOKMARKS, LOG_STORAGE_INFO, LOG_STORAGE_WATERMARK, and LOG_STATS.

FCB2 must provide fcb_getprev(struct fcb *fcb, struct fcb_entry *loc). When loc->fe_range is NULL, it must return the most recent entry; otherwise it must move to an earlier valid entry. It must return FCB_ERR_NOVAR when no previous valid entry exists, and it must handle invalid or unfinished entries and circular sector traversal as required by the FCB2 layout. fcb_offset_last_n must return a non-zero error when no entries are available.

Bookmark support must be available in the log layer: struct log_fcb_bmark and void log_fcb_init_bmarks(struct fcb_log *fcb_log, struct log_fcb_bmark *buf, int bmark_count) must exist. When LOG_FCB_BOOKMARKS is enabled with LOG_FCB2, log walks must use bookmarks without missing, duplicating, or reporting extra entries, and FCB rotation must invalidate bookmarks.

When LOG_STORAGE_INFO and LOG_STORAGE_WATERMARK are enabled with LOG_FCB2, FCB2-backed logs must support log_storage_info and log_set_watermark. log_storage_info must report the total FCB capacity as the sum of the flash sector range sizes, report used space less than total for a partially filled FCB, and report used_unread no greater than used and less than total. log_set_watermark must set the watermark at the requested log index in the FCB2 storage layout.

The FCB2 log handler must support flat and mbuf appends, body appends, reads, walks, and message formatting, and must work when LOG_FCB2 is combined with LOG_STATS.

verification.note: manual: 'must pass the supplied ... cases' (the hidden tests) reworded as the requirement

problem_statement_fixed:

The change must introduce a LOG_FCB2 syscfg setting that selects the FCB2 flash backend for logs. LOG_FCB2 must be mutually exclusive with LOG_FCB and must make log_fcb_handler usable for LOG_FCB2. LOG_FCB2 must also be compatible with LOG_FCB_BOOKMARKS, LOG_STORAGE_INFO, LOG_STORAGE_WATERMARK, and LOG_STATS.

FCB2 must provide fcb_getprev(struct fcb *fcb, struct fcb_entry *loc). When loc->fe_range is NULL, it must return the most recent entry; otherwise it must move to an earlier valid entry. It must return FCB_ERR_NOVAR when no previous valid entry exists, and it must handle invalid or unfinished entries and circular sector traversal as required by the FCB2 layout. fcb_offset_last_n must return a non-zero error when no entries are available.

Bookmark support must be available in the log layer: struct log_fcb_bmark and void log_fcb_init_bmarks(struct fcb_log *fcb_log, struct log_fcb_bmark *buf, int bmark_count) must exist. When LOG_FCB_BOOKMARKS is enabled with LOG_FCB2, log walks must use bookmarks without missing, duplicating, or reporting extra entries, and FCB rotation must invalidate bookmarks.

When LOG_STORAGE_INFO and LOG_STORAGE_WATERMARK are enabled with LOG_FCB2, FCB2-backed logs must support log_storage_info and log_set_watermark. log_storage_info must report the total FCB capacity as the sum of the flash sector range sizes, report used space less than total for a partially filled FCB, and report used_unread no greater than used and less than total. log_set_watermark must set the watermark at the requested log index in the FCB2 storage layout.

The FCB2 log handler must support flat and mbuf appends, body appends, reads, walks, and message formatting, and must work when LOG_FCB2 is combined with LOG_STATS.
